subject: [PATCH v2 6/8] memcg: remove the per-node soft limit tree fields

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch removes the per-node soft limit tree fields from the Linux kernel's memory control group (memcg) code. The removed fields, which were only used for memcg-v1, included a red-black tree node and two unsigned long values. They have been replaced with explicit padding to avoid false sharing between read-mostly and update-often fields in the struct mem_cgroup_per_node.
